chunks: And from him, from Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Fadhal, from Ibn Bukayr, from Zurarah, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
"The sick person is not permitted to divorce, but he is permitted to marry."
ai.seo_question: Can a sick person divorce their spouse according to Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, Imam al-Sadiq (AS) clarifies that while a sick person retains the capacity to contract marriage, they are restricted from initiating unilateral divorce (*talaq*). This ruling reflects the Shia juristic concern that illness may impair judgment or be used strategically to dissolve marital bonds without genuine cause, thereby ensuring stability during the vulnerable period of recovery.
